$roomId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['game','hostUid','status','createdAt','lastSeen']) && newData.child('game').val() === 'ashgrave' && newData.child('hostUid').isString() && newData.child('status').val() in ['live','closed'] && newData.child('createdAt').isNumber() && newData.child('lastSeen').isNumber()
